title: Freelancer cards with rating, earned and rate stats and a Get in Touch CTA (light and dark)
attribution_visible_in_image: A Xiaohongshu watermark with an ID that reads 'sxt417' (as far as legible) at the bottom-right. This is a repost marker, not confirmed authorship.

observed.layout: Two cards on a light-grey page with faint outlined rounded rectangles. Left (light): soft translucent blue shapes as banner, avatar overlapping, name 'Sophia Wilder' with a purple verified badge, role 'Senior Product Designer', green 'Online' dot and label, a tinted rounded stat strip (4.9 'raiting', $53K earned, $50/hr rate) with dividers, black 'Get in Touch' bar. Right (dark): vertical neon stripes banner (blue to magenta), avatar with magenta glow, 'Lia Hartwell', 'Middle Graphic Designer', 'Online', stat strip ($12K earned, $35/hr), white 'Get in Touch' bar.
observed.typography: Neutral sans; semibold names, grey roles. The stat label reads 'raiting' (misspelled).
observed.materials: Light: flat white with soft glass-like banner. Dark: near-black card with glow-ringed avatar.

interpretation.aesthetic: Clean, trustworthy marketplace card in two themes.
implementation_notes: Stat strip: tinted rounded container with three equal columns and dividers.
CTA and surface colors invert between themes.
Banner art can be swapped per user.

concept_work.essence: Credentials with units (rating, earnings, hourly rate) presented as a compact strip before the ask.
what_makes_it_work: Stat values carry units ($53K earned, $50/hr), so meaning is unambiguous.
Online status and verification add trust.
The CTA inversion keeps the action dominant in both themes.
gaps_to_make_it_work: The label 'raiting' is misspelled in both cards.
Light-card 'Online' and stat labels measure about 2.3-3.1:1.
The role text on the light card is about 3.1-3.4:1.

links: Online status and the CTA both answer 'can I contact this person now?'
Stats establish credibility before the CTA.

pattern.name: Credential strip with units before a single CTA
must_preserve: Status and verification near the name
adaptation_examples: Tutor marketplace: stats become lessons taught, rating, price per hour.
Contractor directory: stats become jobs completed, response time, rate.

lessons: Put the unit inside the value and proofread labels in core data.
Combine status and verification near the name to answer 'can I trust and reach this person?'.

related.relation: same stat triple (rating, earned, rate) with unit-bearing values

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
palette: blue shapes in the light banner
measured.color_roles: Neutral page; blue (light) and blue-to-magenta (dark) appear only in the banners; CTA flips black/white.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: A hire-a-freelancer card whose elements all serve contact.
Tidy hierarchy and clear separation between banner, identity and stats.
Stat units are correct, but a misspelled core label ('raiting') is a correctness error.
Status, verification and a single CTA are clear; no hover or loading states.
Two themes derived systematically from the same structure.
A familiar marketplace card with solid execution.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 18.35:1; secondary text min 2.29:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
